newsitem.title: UK: Brent cargo trades at firm June -31 cts-trade.
newsitem.headline: Brent cargo trades at firm June -31 cts-trade.

text.p: A cargo of May loading Brent crude oil traded on Tuesday at a strong June Brent -31 cents, traders said.
The cargo, due to load in the May 6-8 period was sold by a trader and destined to move on a VLCC to the U.S. Gulf, traders said.
This deal compared with a trade on Monday at June -37 cents but buyers said the offer was the best on the market.
"It was the best offer by far. There was no option but to pay up," one potential buyer said.
